# MaioCV

> Digital initiatives for the island of Maio, Cabo Verde (Cape Verde), created by MaioAzul. AI and open data help people explore, research and learn about the island.

The website is in Portuguese. Canonical website: https://www.maio.cv/
MaioCV is an initiative hub, not a government website. Statistics should be attributed to their original datasets, retaining dates, units and methodological limitations.

## Pages
- [Digital initiatives](https://www.maio.cv/): Tourism, open data, APIs and AI tools for Maio.
- [Maio in ChatGPT](https://www.maio.cv/mcp): How to ask questions about the island and explore its data.
- [Sitemap](https://www.maio.cv/sitemap.xml)

## Data and tools
- [Maio Open Data API](https://api.maio.cv): Explore the published API documentation for data access.
- [Portal de Dados](https://portal.maio.cv): Tourism, economy and territory indicators.
- [VisitMaio](https://visitmaio.com): Places, beaches and visitor information.
- [MaioAzul](https://maioazul.com): Creator of MaioCV.

The on-page question examples include prepared answers. Custom questions use a chat service. Prepared examples are not live statistics; consult the linked data sources for current values.

- [Chat with Maio](https://www.maio.cv/chat): Ask questions and follow up using the island’s data tools.
